summary: Aya Gold & Silver furnished a 6-K with a press release dated November 4, 2026, reporting exploration results rather than a special situation. The filing discloses new high-grade infill intercepts along the 5.4 km Boumadine Main Trend in Morocco, including BOU-DD26-1076 at 269 g/t AgEq over 11.9 m and BOU-DD26-1078 at 331 g/t AgEq over 9.1 m, plus three newly granted exploration permits expanding the project area to 357 km2. Year-to-date drilling totals 181,685 m, surpassing the 2026 target ahead of schedule; a feasibility study follows next year. No transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are involved; watch resource-growth and permitting news ahead of the feasibility study as the relevant catalysts.
